--- note
Promoted from matrix cell tex/includegraphics/own-line/w80/desktop (FINDINGS.md #4, rule R-V1).
CM6's moveVertically probes textHeight/2 past the current row's edge, so an image-only line whose rendered box was shorter than that was stepped over entirely: zero-height while the asset is unresolved (this harness resolves nothing), tiny for a small image, and Down from the line above landed on the line below.
.cm-live-image now keeps a minimum caret-sized box (1lh tall, 1ch wide), so the press lands ON the image line, at the widget edge nearest the goal x.
